title: Global smallpox vaccine reserve: report by the Secretariat

sections.title: Page 1

summary.text: Opens a 2004 Secretariat report to WHO's Executive Board on a global smallpox vaccine reserve, recalling the eradication commission's recommendations and the role of vaccine in containing outbreaks. It notes that national vaccine stocks are unevenly distributed and of uncertain quality.

sections.extract: WORLD HEALTH ORGANIZATION EXECUTIVE BOARD EB115/36 115th Session 23 December 2004 Provisional agenda item 4.8 Global smallpox vaccine reserve Report by the Secretariat 1. sections.title: Page 2

summary.text: Describes plans for a global smallpox vaccine reserve reviewed by WHO's Ad Hoc Committee on Orthopoxvirus Infections, including pledged and physical stockpiles and a target number of doses. It adds that WHO is finalizing an operational framework covering vaccine specifications, procurement, storage, liability and release procedures.

sections.extract: EB115/36 2 PLANS TO ESTABLISH A GLOBAL SMALLPOX VACCINE RESERVE 5. A proposal to establish a global smallpox vaccine reserve was reviewed by the WHO Ad Hoc Committee on Orthopoxvirus Infections, which met in Geneva from 31 August to 1 September 2004. sections.title: Page 3

summary.text: Invites the Executive Board to note the report and progress on establishing the global smallpox vaccine reserve.
